Othor AI reads the company’s databases and sheets (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Google Sheets) in place, decides what to look at, and tests every confirmed number every night with 11 statistical checks (12 with External Signals); in the Enterprise Edition, Discover finds the groups of numbers nobody set up, such as collections, dispatch or customer health, and keeps each one as a page of its own.

- The open core is open source (Apache-2.0); it runs on othor.ai or on the company’s own servers. [...] ## What Othor AI never does

- Never writes a number. Every figure is computed by code from your data. A number in AI-drafted text that isn’t in the computed results is thrown away.
- Never copies your tables. Results are kept; your data stays where it is.
- Never reads personal columns. They’re excluded at the scan and never queried, sampled or sent anywhere.
- Never needs a model at night. The run, the tests and every figure work with AI switched off; only the wording falls back to templates.
- Never changes anything on its own. Drafts only. Nothing changes until you apply it.

results.content: Meet your AI head of intelligence. Othor AI is a proactive decision intelligence platform that continuously monitors your organisation's data and delivers AI-generated intelligence briefs to leadership — before they ask. Unlike traditional BI tools that wait for users to open dashboards or run queries, Othor operates on a schedule: every morning it scans data across connected sources, identifies meaningful signals, and synthesises them into structured Decision Briefs tailored to specific business questions such as revenue health, product traction, or operational efficiency. The platform has two layers of AI agents. Analyst Agents go deep into each data source to detect anomalies, track KPI movements, and generate narratives explaining what changed. Decision Brief Agents then synthesise [...] what changed. Decision Brief Agents then synthesise these outputs — along with historical trends, forecasts, and leadership-defined goals — into a single, consumable intelligence report. Leaders receive a clear executive summary, KPI cards, insight charts, and AI-generated strategic questions every day, enabling them to move from data to decision without navigating dashboards or waiting on analysts. Othor is not a chat-with-data tool. It is a push-based intelligence layer that sits above existing analytics systems and eliminates decision friction for founders, CXOs, and senior leadership teams.
